patch.description: Developer-only export hook: RADV radv_shader.c shader_compile() captures the final ACO output (raw code, aco_callback config/symbols, post-radv_postprocess_binary_config RSRC1/2/3, ac_shader_args slot table with field names, RADV compute regs, aco options/info, device identity, final NIR) when RADV_ACO_EXPORT_DIR is set; ACO register allocation records max-used VGPR/SGPR (aco_export_ra_max_used_*); aco_interface.cpp measures ordinary SGPR/VGPR use, per-SGPR read/def masks and typed entry liveness from the final typed post-RA instructions (aco_export_typed_*). No codegen change.
